shot.continuity: one take, camera in motion in every segment, never locked off
shot.framing: vertical, the sunlit meadow floor fills the lower half at all times

subject.character: fat groundhog in a knitted vest, standing at the mouth of his burrow in a bright summer meadow, microphone at his muzzle
subject.physicality: round heavy body, half-lidded eyes, deadpan, blinks slowly, cheeks stuffed
subject.anti_action: sorts seeds into perfectly straight rows at blinding speed, dead serious

props: the burrow works three times: he leans out of it, he stuffs the seeds down into it, and at the end it swallows him whole
environment: bright summer meadow at noon, pale dry grass, sunlit sandy earth around the burrow, sunflower seeds
lighting: hard midday sun straight overhead — the pale grass and sand are the brightest surfaces and all action happens on them, deep black inside the burrow for contrast, seeds catch the sun and throw moving glints

audio.delivery: fast, clipped, bored deadpan, male voice
audio.pacing: rapid; all speech inside the first five seconds

timeline.a: shoots up out of the burrow at the lens, showering sand across the frame
timeline.cam: lens at ground level; sun flares as he blocks it

timeline.a: spoken fast. Sweeps a heap of seeds toward himself with both paws
timeline.cam: pushes in from paws to face

timeline.a: spoken fast. Slaps a paw over the heap, dust jumps, stares into lens
timeline.cam: orbits right, dry grass passing close across the lens

timeline.a: sorts the seeds into perfectly straight rows at blinding speed, face unmoving
timeline.cam: cranes into a top-down over the rows, still turning

timeline.a: spoken fast. Flicks one seed out of the row with a claw
timeline.cam: cranes down low, grass swaying into frame

timeline.a: spoken fast. Cheeks puff, tail whips and knocks the rows apart, seeds scattering
timeline.cam: handheld jolt on the tail hit

timeline.a: a magpie drops onto his shoulder, wings wide, and snatches a beakful of seeds
timeline.cam: circles him at ground height; wings cut the sunlight

timeline.a: he grooms a paw in fast licks, eyes sliding to the gap in the rows
timeline.cam: drifts in on his face; grass shadows cross it

timeline.a: he tips his head over the burrow mouth and lets the whole load of seeds pour out of his cheeks into the dark
timeline.cam: tracks the pouring seeds down into the burrow

timeline.a: spoken fast, calm. Rakes every last seed off the sand into the burrow with one wide sweep
timeline.cam: follows the sweeping paw and the pouring seeds

timeline.a: smiles once — the only smile — and drops straight down into the burrow
timeline.cam: pushes in on the burrow mouth as he disappears

timeline.a: bare sand, no seeds left. The magpie lands beside the hole, picks up the last seed in its beak and flies off
timeline.cam: cranes down to sand level, following the magpie
